senses.gloss: m. pl. (פָּקַל; cmp. פּוּקְלָא) cotton tufts.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 17a:72">Nidd. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>בפ׳ או בצמר וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>בפוקלין</he>) with cotton tufts or with wool clean and soft.
<cite ref="Niddah 17a:66">Ib.</cite> (Chald.) <he>מאן בעי פ׳ דנהמא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>פְּקוֹלֵי בנ׳</he>) who wants cotton tufts for the bed (v. <cite ref="N00273"><he>נַהֲמָא</he></cite>)?
